paragraphs.text:
You decide on a fair bid for the gemstone-studded altar and 
submit your offer. Not long after, Mr. Warren empties the ballot 
box and begins sifting through the entries for the highest bid.

• Make an Appraise or Credit Rating roll, both at Hard difficulty 
(success only at equal to or below half of the skill’s value): if you 
succeed, go to 19; if you fail, go to 59.
